Chapter 332: Chapter 2: Fifty Years Later (Subscribe Please)

Chapter 332: Chapter 2: Fifty Years Later (Subscribe Please)

“Over there…”

Lin Yuan’s mind tensed up.

Since his consciousness had descended into this world,

Lin Yuan had only encountered various kinds of demonic beasts and feral creatures.

As for others, he had seldom come into contact with them.

The main reason was that Lin Yuan was located in the Yunwu Mountain Range, which was a paradise for demonic and feral beasts.

...

“Is someone coming?”

Lin Yuan extended his senses and discovered that a young man and woman were approaching from several miles away.

“Senior brother, choosing Yunwu Mountain Range as the place for our training expedition, isn’t it too risky?”

The young woman said in a low, cautious voice.

“How do you capture tiger cubs without entering the tiger’s den? Junior sister, nowadays our sect has brought out many foundational heritages to resist the invasion of the Foreign Evil God,”

“As long as we can get through this training, we will gain great benefits and opportunities…”

The young man continued, “Yunwu Mountain Range, although dangerous, those demonic beasts are much easier to deal with than the puppets of the Foreign Evil God. If we are afraid of these beasts, how will we deal with the Foreign Evil God in the future?”

“What you say makes sense, senior brother.”

Hearing this, the young woman looked at the young man with admiration in her gaze.

…

Several miles away,

Lin Yuan cautiously observed the young couple.

Due to the language barrier, Lin Yuan didn’t know what they were actually saying,

but through their expressions and behavior, he deduced that the young man and woman likely came from an external force.

“Equivalent to the Second Layer, probably disciples…”

Lin Yuan thought to himself, the time flow speed in this world compared to the Main World was six hundred to one, which absolutely shouldn’t be underestimated; the strongest might reach Seventh-Rank Peak.

…

Since discovering the young man and woman,

Lin Yuan spent most of his time observing them.

Regarding making a move to capture them? Without thoroughly understanding the young couple’s strengths, Lin Yuan absolutely would not make a move.

Who knows if this young couple might have some powerful elder,

would killing them draw the attention of this elder?

Lin Yuan’s observation of the young couple was primarily to learn their language.

With his Against-Heaven’s Understanding, Lin Yuan could generally learn anything after seeing and hearing it once.

Learning a completely new language was no difficulty at all.

He only needed to remember their pronunciation, and by recalling the tone and expressions used during those pronunciations, he could roughly figure it out.

…

“Tianqing World?”

“Tianqing Great Alliance?”

Half a month later, Lin Yuan had eavesdropped a lot of useful information from the young couple.

Firstly, this place was called Tianqing World, and currently, the strongest faction here was the Tianqing Great Alliance.

The Tianqing Great Alliance was a colossal entity formed from countless forces within Tianqing World to counter the invasion of the Foreign Evil God.

“Indeed, the Foreign Evil God has already started their move…”

Lin Yuan pondered thoughtfully; perhaps many years ago, the Foreign Evil God had started invading this world but had never succeeded.

That’s why the Ancestral Demon Tree had scattered its countless seeds into Tianqing World, attempting to invade through other means.

“That Alliance Hierarch of the Tianqing Great Alliance, his strength must have reached the Seventh Rank, and he’s not just any Seventh Rank…”

Lin Yuan often heard the young man speak admiringly of the Alliance Hierarch.

Over the years of the Foreign Evil God’s invasion, if it weren’t for the Alliance Hierarch repeatedly stopping the chaos, the situation would likely be much worse than it is now, allowing them to leisurely enter the Black Mist Mountain Range for training?

“They’re returning.”

Lin Yuan gazed ‘towards’ the young couple.

After hunting several Second Layer demonic beasts, the couple had completed their training task and planned to return to their sect to claim their rewards.

Lin Yuan didn’t stop them because there was no need; they hadn’t noticed him, and making a move would only reveal his presence.

“Continue the hunt.”

Once the young couple had completely left, Lin Yuan resumed his hunting of the demonic beasts.

Now reaching seven to eight meters in size, ordinary First or Second Layer beasts couldn’t escape once they came within a hundred meters, all becoming Lin Yuan’s nourishment.

Several days later,

“It’s time to leave.”

Now that the surrounding demonic beasts had almost been hunted to extinction, to maintain his current rate of cultivation, he must move to another region to repeat the hunt.

Lin Yuan looked towards the depths of Yunwu Mountain Range, planning to move in that direction.

The closer to the depths of Yunwu Mountain Range, the denser the spiritual energy of heaven and earth became, and similarly, the stronger the demonic beasts, which naturally helped Lin Yuan even more.

“However, before leaving, it might be worth dealing with that group underground.”

Lin Yuan’s gaze shifted towards the ground,

Yunwu Mountain Range, one of the top ten mountain ranges in Tianqing World, was vast and extensive, inhabited by countless demonic and feral beasts.

A large portion of these beasts lived on the surface,

yet still, there were traces of demonic beasts underground.

The ‘group’ Lin Yuan referred to was a group of ‘Earthrock Mice’.

These rodent demonic beasts liked to live underground, leveraging their abilities to burrow countless ‘tunnels’, even building a rodent Underground Palace a hundred meters below the surface.

Essentially a rodent dynasty.

Lin Yuan had discovered the traces of these Earthrock Mice when he inadvertently entered a ‘tunnel’ while exploring the underground with his roots, eventually finding their trails.

“Probably over three hundred Earthrock Mice, the Mouse King has Second Layer strength…”

Lin Yuan thought; the size of the Earthrock Mice was not smaller than that of a Purple-Eyed Rabbit, close to half a meter, and the Earthrock Mouse King was even two meters in size.
